lines.text: The LORD promises to restore the fallen tent of David and rebuild it as in the days of old.
David's tent is rebuilt so they may possess the remnant of Moab and all the nations that bear His name.
The days are coming when the plowman will overtake the reaper, and the mountains will drip with sweet wine.
The LORD will restore Israel from captivity, and they will plant vineyards, drink wine, make gardens, and eat fruit.
The LORD will firmly plant Israel in the land of Egypt, never again to be uprooted.
